summary: MP3 Huffman table builder: reads stream bytes through the stream-state struct at this+0x14 (refilled by the callback stored at index 3 when exhausted), decodes per-entry control bytes (low nibble = table index into a lazily allocated buffer slot at this + 36 + index via VTableAllocNullTerminate, high nibble = value flag), fills the selected WORD table from the position table dword_5AF778..dword_5AF878 using 1- or 2-byte (big-endian) values, and when the batch-count field at obj+0x68 is >= 2 emits eight 8-WORD batches into the obj+0x18..0x34 word-batch fields through the obj vtable dispatch (states 80, 30, 92), persisting the stream pointer/count on exit.

operations.description: Resolve obj = *a1 (the state dispatcher object at this+0x00) and the stream-state struct v1 = a1[5] (pointer at this+0x14); from v1 read the current byte pointer v1[0] (field 0x00) and the remaining byte count v1[1].
Guard: if the remaining count v1[1] is zero, invoke the refill callback v1[3](a1); a zero return aborts the decoder with return 0. The callback is an indirect call stored in the stream-state struct.
Build a 16-bit value from the next stream bytes: the first byte is shifted into the high byte (v25) and the next byte is added, forming the initial big-endian accumulator v26 = *v4 + v25.

Main entry loop: each iteration consumes one byte; the low nibble is the table index written to obj+0x18, the high nibble is the value flag written to obj+0x1C; the state word at obj+0x14 is set to 80 and the vtable entry at obj+0x04 is dispatched with (a1, 1).
Guard: a table index >= 4 is invalid; the state word at obj+0x14 is set to 30, the index is written to obj+0x18, and the vtable entry at obj+0x00 is dispatched with (a1) before continuing.
Select the table buffer slot at this + 36 + index (a1[index + 36]); if empty, allocate it with VTableAllocNullTerminate(a1) (0x00516974).

Fill loop: iterate the position table from dword_5AF778 to dword_5AF878; for each position read one stream byte, or two bytes (big-endian) when the value flag is set, and store the WORD into the table buffer at buffer + 2 * position.
Guard: when the batch-count field at obj+0x68 is >= 2, run the 64-WORD batch output stage.

Batch output loop: copy the eight WORD slots starting at table buffer + 4 into the obj+0x18..0x34 word-batch fields (obj+0x18, 0x1C, 0x20, 0x24, 0x28, 0x2C, 0x30, 0x34), set the state word at obj+0x14 to 92, dispatch vtable+4 with (a1, 2), and advance eight slots; repeated 8 times for a total of 64 WORDs.
Decrement the per-entry remaining-work counter v27 by 65, and additionally by 64 when the value flag was set.
Persist stream state: write the remaining count back to v1[1] and the current byte pointer back to v1[0]; return 1 on success.
